user.title: Set up Cat Bowl Monitor
user.description: Uses an OpenAI-compatible vision provider to check two food bowls on a schedule. Images are sent to the configured provider. Only bounded latest/before/after image slots are retained. Leave the direct-provider fields blank to reuse UBox Camera.
